title.rendered: Did you know a car-free city?

content.rendered:
In Venice, there are no roads for cars. Built across more than 100 small islands connected by canals, the city relies on boats, water taxis, gondolas, and footpaths for transportation.

Instead of traffic lights and highways, Venice has waterways, with the famous Grand Canal serving as its main thoroughfare. This unique design has made it one of the most recognisable cities in the world, proving that an entire city can function without a single car.
